messages.subject: Project Zephyr — first draft Patent & Technology Licence (v1)
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair, Nadia,

Good to be working with you. Attached is our first draft of the Patent and Technology Licence Agreement (v1) for Project Zephyr, reflecting the term sheet positions. Key schedules: Schedule 1 (licensed patents), Schedule 3 (financial terms), Schedule 4 (deployment milestones).

We've drafted the exclusivity at clause 2.2 (three years, retail fulfilment field), royalty at Schedule 3 (5.0%, £2m cap), and the liability cap at clause 8.3 (£5m per 12 months). We look forward to your mark-up.

Kind regards,
James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Corporate & Technology
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0519

This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
